name: index-plugin
description: An Obsidian plugin for working with indexes.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/daily-links.test.ts tests/index-document.test.ts tests/index-path.test.ts tests/migration-plan.test.ts tests/note-name.test.ts tests/settings.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
